items.name: covering_node
items.signature: fn covering_node(root: AnyNodeRef<'_>, range: ruff_text_size::TextRange) -> CoveringNode<'_>
items.summary: Returns the node with a minimal range that fully contains `range`.

items.name: CoveringNode
items.summary: The node with a minimal range that fully contains the search range.

methods.name: ancestors
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the ancestor nodes, starting with the node itself and walking towards the root.

methods.name: find_first
methods.signature: fn find_first(self, f: impl Fn(AnyNodeRef<'a>) -> bool) -> Result<Self, Self>
methods.summary: Finds the first node that fully covers the range and fulfills the given predicate.

methods.name: find_last
methods.signature: fn find_last(self, f: impl Fn(AnyNodeRef<'a>) -> bool) -> Result<Self, Self>
methods.summary: Finds the last node that fully covers the range and fulfills the given predicate.

methods.name: from_ancestors
methods.summary: Creates a new `CoveringNode` from a list of ancestor nodes. The ancestors should be ordered from root to the covering node.
